purpose: Test whether a middle wide-corridor candidate preserves Archer line identity and protected specialist positioning better than either ordinary narrow width or near-screen-wide coverage.

MID_ADJACENT.meaning: hits aim band plus immediately adjacent diagnostic bands

FULL5.meaning: covers all five diagnostic bands; overbroad comparison endpoint only

reason: Preserves unlimited depth when enemies are actually aligned.
Expands the huge-arrow fantasy into nearby geometry.
Does not automatically erase deliberately off-corridor SUPPORTER/SIEGER protection.
Avoids converting Archer into a screen-wide AoE class.
